content.text:
I notice the ray stops at solid non-background cells but slips through gaps in box outlines — in the example, gaps in the 3-box and 9-box let the ray pass column 7 until it hits the 6 row. I want to build a couple more demos like this, starting with a simpler 13x13 grid with a box that has an intentional gap in one column.

Building the grid rows...

For the second demo, I'll use just a single box with the gap positioned on the bottom side instead.
